subject: HelioMed dedicated capacity: pricing & credit escalation
messages:
From: Sarah Ng <sarah@heliomed.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU pool — final pricing ask

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. HelioMed is evaluating a dedicated capacity plan to run our inference pipelines for imaging and clinical NLP. We ran the internal sizing exercise and are targeting a committed pool equivalent to ~80 A100 GPUs (24/7 footprint), with an expected steady-state throughput of ~1.8B tokens/month and spike headroom up to 2.6B tokens.

Two quick asks we need to resolve before legal/procurement will move forward:
- Pricing: our procurement prefers a final committed discount of 35% off list (GigaCloud has offered a competing 30% + 2 months free).
- Onboarding credits: 3 months of consumption credits to cover migration and eval.

We can commit to a 24-month reserved term if the above is available and we get a latency SLO (p50 < 40ms, p99 < 250ms) and basic SOC2 evidence. Attached is our RFP and estimated usage profile. Can your team tell me whether Redwood can get to those commercials or whether we need to escalate to your execs?

Thanks,
Sarah Ng
Head of ML Ops
HelioMed, Inc.
Attachment: RFP_HelioMed_2026.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sarah Ng <sarah@heliomed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — final pricing ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the RFP. Appreciate the transparency on GigaCloud's position. I'm looping in Marissa (your AE) and Vivek (sales lead) so we can triage internally and come back with an approved commercial path.

Short answer: we can get close, but the 35% ask and 3 months credits are outside standard delegated authority for a 24-month commit at this scale. Marissa — can you prepare a commercial counter (discount + credits) and a quick rationale for exec sign-off? Vivek — would like your read on strategic concession room given HelioMed's healthcare profile and compliance requirements.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Account Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Ng <sarah@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — final pricing ask

Laura / Vivek / Sarah — thanks. Summary of commercial thinking and proposed counter:

Rationale:
- HelioMed is strategically attractive: healthcare vertical, potential for multi-account expansion (device analytics + clinical NLP), and high likelihood of paying for observability add-ons.
- Competitive pressure from GigaCloud at 30% + 2 months.

Proposed counter (internal preference):
- Discount: 25% off list for a 24-month committed term
- Onboarding credits: 1.5 months of usage credits applied in first 3 bills
- SLA: p50/p99 targets as requested; legal to accept standard healthcare addendum
- Contractual: one-time right to reevaluate pricing after 12 months if utilization + MRR growth targets not met

If we need to get to 30% or above (and 2–3 months credits), we should escalate to execs for a strategic concession. I attached a quick pricing worksheet with line-item cost impact.

Attachment: proposed_commit_pricing.xlsx

Marissa
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-21T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — final pricing ask (escalation recommended)

Team — I reviewed Marissa's worksheet. Given HelioMed's speed to revenue and the risk that GigaCloud will aggressively undercut us, I'm happy to recommend an escalated concession but with controls:

Escalated ask (seek Ben/RevOps approval):
- Up to 28% discount for a 24-month reserved commit if HelioMed signs within 30 days and provides an EPD-level letter of intent.
- Onboarding credits: cap at 2 months consumption credits.
- Require a 90-day SKU migration clause and a minimum annualized committed spend floor to prevent immediate re-trading.
- Price protection: prorated rollback if HelioMed drops below utilization thresholds.

Quote: Q-2026-587 (provisional). If Ben and RevOps approve, we'll prepare an updated SOW and routing to legal for a limited indemnity addendum for healthcare data handling.

Vivek
VP, Strategic Sales
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — final pricing ask (executive approval)

Thanks for the write-up. I approve a conditional concession for HelioMed given the strategic upside, subject to RevOps and Legal sign-off. Conditions:
1) Maximum concession: 28% discount off list for 24 months.
2) Onboarding credits limited to 2 months consumption credits (applied as bill credits).
3) HelioMed must sign the SOW and Terms within 30 days and provide an executive sign-off (EPD or CFO).
4) Require a financial floor: minimum annualized committed spend of $1.2M, with a prorated rollback if utilization falls below 70% after month 6.
5) Legal to accept our limited healthcare addendum; no broad indemnities.

Aditya — please confirm RevOps can build Q-2026-587 with the above guardrails and issue the revised quote + DocuSign envelope.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sarah Ng <sarah@heliomed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Final commercial position (Q-2026-587) — HelioMed

Hi Sarah — quick update and next steps. Ben has approved a conditional concession to help close this:

What we can offer now (subject to signature and legal review):
- 28% discount off list for a 24-month reserved GPU pool (Q-2026-587).
- Onboarding credits: 2 months consumption credits applied to first invoices.
- SLA targets: p50 < 40ms, p99 < 250ms (operationally backed; legal to accept healthcare addendum).
- Minimum annualized committed spend: $1.2M; utilization rollback if <70% after month 6.

Next steps:
1) I'll share the SOW and DocuSign link for signature (SOW_HelioMed_Q-2026-587.pdf).
2) Procurement to route to legal for the limited indemnity addendum and sign-off on redlines (we'll accept a small number of security clauses typical for healthcare customers).

If this aligns, can you confirm procurement contact and who will sign at your end? Once confirmed, RevOps will issue the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Account Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_HelioMed_Q-2026-587.pdf, redlined_terms_heliomed.docx
